quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Puts $71.9 Million Blackwell Agreement into (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Signed contracts: with the $240.9 million in agreements announced last month, QumulusAI's cumulative signed customer contract value reached $523.4 million, surpassing $500 million for the first time and up 85% from the $282.5 million reported with its Q2 2026 results. Combined, the agreements translate into about $209 million in annual recurring revenue on their initial terms, excluding extension options: about $128 million from the 8 MW active by month-end, about $71 million from the 3.75 MW in Atlanta and the balance from the $29.1 million agreement (customers not named).
quarterly_data.figure: cumulative signed contract value $523.4 million (up 85% from $282.5 million); about $209 million ARR (about $128 million from 8 MW, about $71 million from 3.75 MW Atlanta)

quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Puts $71.9 Million Blackwell Agreement into (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: all 11.75 MW of QumulusAI's contracted capacity across six colocation sites is sold; 7 MW are active and generating revenue today. CEO Michael Maniscalco: 'Our second-quarter revenue of $6.7 million reflected what we had deployed, not what we had sold. Revenue follows handoff, and the handoffs are happening now. All of our capacity is under contract, and we already have a customer signed for the next site, so our focus is on securing the next block.'
quarterly_data.figure: 11.75 MW contracted capacity, all sold; 7 MW active; six colocation sites

quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Puts $71.9 Million Blackwell Agreement into (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Deployment: QumulusAI completed the final NVIDIA B300 handoff under its $71.9 million, three-year Blackwell agreement (B300 capacity at its Kansas City site on Oct. 1, after the B200 capacity on Sept. 8), putting every GPU under that agreement into production and billing 10 weeks after signing. Activation timing: a further 1 MW, already energized, is scheduled for final handoff at the end of this month, bringing active, revenue-generating capacity to 8 MW; the remaining 3.75 MW at the metro Atlanta site (sold under the $211.9 million, three-year take-or-pay agreement) is targeted for activation in early 2027; the $29.1 million agreement will be deployed at an additional site.
quarterly_data.figure: B300 handoff Oct. 1 (Kansas City); production and billing 10 weeks after signing; 1 MW handoff at month-end to 8 MW active; 3.75 MW Atlanta targeted early 2027
